result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, **I'd recommend Linear if you're building a tech or SaaS company, and ClickUp if you need one tool to manage the entire business.**

The best project management tool for a startup isn't necessarily the one with the most features. It's the one your team will actually use, that keeps everyone aligned without creating unnecessary admin work.

Here are the tools I'd shortlist.

## Best project management tools for startups

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product and engineering workflows
- Issues, sprints, roadmaps and priorities
- Fast, clean interface
- Integrates with GitHub

**My pick\:** SaaS, software and AI startups.

[Visit Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Business Project Management Software by ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/npUgY1o0uOvDYR6pwMTGAuP2tBd-lr6s7O9eu43nYufSB6J9BATVFlgdXvoInrHU7ogY9HANPFyo_KAQ3YJm1HbzjmHdrW96zoRMTkzn3FGLwUss-SGlppcbZNvM69AmgrrJxZPYe5xdFODxzsE8d5PHlaQsAyt1FtyH_YdtO84VurPiOx0pWj1qHLiVs_Bl?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one)

- Tasks, projects, documents and goals
- Dashboards and automation
- Highly customizable
- Useful for multiple departments

**My pick\:** Startups wanting one central workspace.

[Visit ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Introducing Status for remote work • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/JoierB-tO_00cduG2D81oKuCvdoyZCElp3bd35lcWALcBpW38axGIp0CC5GaQbqWOOkxY6bkkYIgINigcMs7b9WeuaVIp_po7Lw148-t-fKTF_zSNsVOvmWGGRaLv9NtvMW858uJe_Q2tTfzckYfVF8jui4Tyz-v30ONFO8slcrt9_8tb3TIFzeV-apOQxtA?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Asana**

- Great task ownership and accountability
- Project timelines and dependencies
- Easy for non-technical teams

**My pick\:** Startups coordinating marketing, sales, operations and product.

[Visit Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Notion**

- Project tracking and documentation together
- Company wiki and meeting notes
- Flexible databases and templates

**My pick\:** Early-stage teams that want to keep everything organized.

[Visit Notion](https://notion.so/)

---

![Logiciel de gestion de projets | monday.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/AGLC0Xsp-rKstoXsyE6UCQfot3lTpB5cGra6xvTB-1Y-qIA05m9_6HsnuIkFXzG46Gdq0IyVInVwNUGPugF02K85XBGt2B7g_m0JBT62CyuGLR87_WyvYcanfNCRIgGLOpxv6O7TSm-Ik4NJ7iGSyfd0i6QBhld455AzsGClawDFf8KDZZY7FV7QUZkaNONC?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Visual project dashboards
- Workflow automation
- Marketing and operations planning

**My pick\:** Startups with multiple departments and complex workflows.

[Visit Monday.com](https://monday.com/)

These choices are consistent with recent 2026 comparisons of startup project management platforms. ## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 founders | Notion or Trello |
| 5–15 employees | ClickUp or Linear |
| 15–50 employees | ClickUp or Asana |
| Software/AI startup | Linear |
| Multiple departments | ClickUp or Monday.com |
